rationale: C21 is a direct, material drafting template: it authorizes inspection of the same categories of returns by the same House Committee on Un-American Activities for investigations under the same House-rule mechanism, using nearly identical wording and the same Treasury Decisions. The child principally updates the tax-return endpoint, Congress, rule clause, resolution date, presidential-reference wording, and effective-date phrasing. C24 and C10 are earlier iterations of the same committee-specific template but are more temporally remote and include additional tax categories.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1961, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-seventh Congress, be open to inspection by the Committee on Un-American Activities, House of Representatives, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1959, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-sixth Congress, be open to inspection by the Committee on Un-American Activities, House of Representatives, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.explanation: The core authorization is virtually verbatim, with only the return endpoint and congressional session updated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: for the purpose of carrying on those investigations authorized by clause 18 of Rule XI of the Rules of the House of Representatives, agreed to January 3, 1961
shared_material.parent_excerpt: for the purpose of carrying on those investigations authorized by clause 17 of Rule XI of the Rules of the House of Representatives, agreed to January 7, 1959
shared_material.explanation: The same committee-specific legal-purpose clause is retained while the rule-clause number and adoption date are updated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133 relating to the inspection of returns by committees of the Congress approved by the President on May 3, 1955
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, relating to the inspection of returns by committees of the Congress, approved by me on May 3, 1955
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the same administrative machinery and Treasury Decisions, changing only the presidential-reference wording.
